_note: Herds: wool, milk, meat, hides, tallow and horn as joint products of a flock or herd on pasture (Complaints/532). Each recipe is a batch of 100 head-years; the figures are the species rows of data/world/living_stock.json.

wool_kg.basis: per herd of 100 head kept for a year (sheep_kg)
wool_kg.yield_basis: SHEEP FLOCK, wool and mutton. A shepherd tends about 150 head (recalled; Varro's De re rustica has flocks of about a hundred, not opened); shearing takes 0.4 hour a head with hand shears; 3 hours to slaughter, flay and joint a carcass. The products come together from one animal-year: a herd cannot give more wool without more hides and meat. Each figure is the species row's in data/world/living_stock.json times 100 head (its source names what was read and what is recalled): the stocking rate sets the land, offtake share x live weight x dressing percentage is the carcass, of which rendered fat is split off as fat_kg and the rest is meat_kg (bone-in), the raw skin is a share of live weight, salt is the lick. The herd is a held living stock that the gate node holds, so a society without the animal cannot make any of this; the herd is not charged as capital because the stock has no production entry yet (Complaints/365, 366). Labour is herding at 2400 hours a herder-year (8 hours, 300 days; recalled) shared among the head a herder tends, plus the work named here. Meat is valued as food at 0.4 of wheat a kilogram in data/world/needs.json (see Complaints/532). Conf D throughout; the cost is split among the outputs by mass, because no sole-output route gives a reference price (sim/engine/joint_allocation.py, retire: Complaints/507).

meat_kg.basis: per herd of 100 head kept for a year (cattle_kg)
meat_kg.yield_basis: CATTLE HERD, beef, milk and hides. A herder tends about 80 head; the cows that calve (0.5 x 0.587 of the herd) are milked twice a day for 210 days at 0.1 hour a cow; 8 hours to slaughter, flay and joint a carcass. sheep_kg.basis: per hectare of breeding pasture per year, output as kg of live weight added to a herd
sheep_kg.yield_basis: GROWN. A hectare carries the species' head per hectare at its live weight, and the herd adds its natural increase in a year (rates and sources in data/world/living_stock.json; the products it gives meanwhile are in the herd recipes of this file). Labour is the herder's year (2400 hours, recalled) shared among the 150 head a herder tends, for the head on the hectare. LAND: the batch is one hectare-year, converted to hectare_land's unit as in wheat_kg's LAND note. Conf D. Made only where the herd is already held, so the stock cannot be had without a society that holds it.
